text: Ln_LHR may represent a promising, readily available prognostic biomarker for sepsis mortality risk stratification, with a clinically meaningful threshold effect. This composite marker integrates critical pathophysiological information and may enhance risk assessment and guide clinical decision-making in sepsis management.
source_label: Logarithmically transformed lactate-to-hemoglobin ratio demonstrates a threshold effect on 28-day mortality in sepsis: Analysis of the MIMIC-IV database
